provenance.source_title: Your Life After Faking Your Own Death

examples.psychological_goal: 用章节卡+年龄定格把观众直接按进人物处境
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级章节卡+第二人称定格（Level one... You are 38）
examples.example_text: Level one, the drowning man. You are 38 years old.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第X级+绰号」开场卡与一句年龄/场景定格，零铺垫入场
examples.negative_instruction: 绰号必须概括该级处境，不可用花哨形容词

examples.psychological_goal: 用物证清单代替情绪形容词
examples.expression_mechanism: 物证堆叠（红字/最后通知/不拆的信封）
examples.example_text: In front of you are the bills, red ink, final notices, a stack of envelopes you stopped opening weeks ago.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把绝望写成桌面上的具体物件，让读者自己感到窒息
examples.negative_instruction: 物件必须可拍照般具体，不写「他很绝望」

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句平行账把禁忌念头合理化
examples.expression_mechanism: 死者账本平行句（不欠钱/值$400,000）
examples.example_text: Dead men do not owe money to anyone. Dead men are worth $400,000 to the people they leave behind.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一主语的平行短句，让越界念头显得像冷静算术
examples.negative_instruction: 平行句必须推进一层（免责→得利），不可同义重复

examples.psychological_goal: 把「决定」写成发生在身上的事
examples.expression_mechanism: 念头拟物化（墙上开了一扇门）
examples.example_text: It does not feel like a decision at all. It feels like a door opening in a wall you thought was solid.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不像A，像B」的比喻把主动选择改写成被动降临
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻的意象必须与全片母题一致（门/墙），不可随手取喻

examples.psychological_goal: 给出反直觉的方法论规则
examples.expression_mechanism: 幸存者偏差反转（只从失败者学）
examples.example_text: You do not learn from the ones who succeeded. The ones who succeeded, you never hear about.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「成功者不可见」的反转句给方法论立规矩
examples.negative_instruction: 反转必须紧接着具体操作（学失败者的哪三个错误）

examples.psychological_goal: 用身份翻转判词收束一个阶段
examples.expression_mechanism: 身份翻转+恐惧对照（不再是绝望者，是有计划的人）
examples.example_text: You are not a desperate man anymore. You are a man with a plan. And that frightens you more than the debt ever did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不再是A，是B」收束阶段，并用第三句把成就感扭回恐惧
examples.negative_instruction: 第三句的情绪反转是必需项，不可停在励志感

examples.psychological_goal: 把代价压到最无辜的人身上
examples.expression_mechanism: 空棺材+真心流泪的并置
examples.example_text: Your own wife will have to bury an empty coffin and mean every tear.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「假的仪式+真的情感」并置，让计划的代价具体化
examples.negative_instruction: 句子必须是陈述计划而非抒情，克制才有重锤

examples.psychological_goal: 用最小日常动作装最大的告别
examples.expression_mechanism: 告别藏进日常（多读一个故事）
examples.example_text: She asks why she gets an extra one. You say because you love her.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把诀别写进一个无法解释的小动作，对话越少越痛
examples.negative_instruction: 动作必须小到对方不会起疑，不可写成煽情告别

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句话讲清「布景即叙事」的原则
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化规则句（场景自己讲故事）
examples.example_text: The scene has to tell the story without you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把技术规程压成一句拟人化原则
examples.negative_instruction: 原则句前要已展示清单（钱包/手机/鞋），不可空讲原则

examples.psychological_goal: 用反讽意象戳破「值得感」
examples.expression_mechanism: 反讽溺水（肺里满是空气的溺水）
examples.example_text: Now that it is real, it does not feel like freedom. It feels like drowning with your lungs still full of air.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用与主题意象（溺水）自相矛盾的变体做情绪判词
examples.negative_instruction: 反讽意象必须呼应全片母题，不可用通用痛苦比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用材料清单定义一种生存方式
examples.expression_mechanism: 材料拟人（纸和现金做成的人）
examples.example_text: You become a man made of paper and cash.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「由X和Y做成的人」概括一整套生存规则
examples.negative_instruction: 材料必须都是前文立过规矩的具体物，不可抽象

examples.psychological_goal: 用递进比较写「成功」的变质
examples.expression_mechanism: 奇异递进（奇怪→更奇怪的是解脱）
examples.example_text: It is strange to read about your own death. It is stranger to feel relief while you do.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用strange→stranger的递进，把「计划成功」写成自我惊吓
examples.negative_instruction: 递进第二级必须是道德上不该有的情绪，不可平淡

examples.psychological_goal: 用鬼喻重定义观看行为
examples.expression_mechanism: 鬼喻（通过屏幕缠着家人的鬼）
examples.example_text: You are a ghost haunting your own family through a screen.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把现代行为（偷看社交页）重命名为一个古老恐怖角色
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻两端的机制必须严格同构（能见不能触）

examples.psychological_goal: 给出被捕的机制定律
examples.expression_mechanism: 大小反转定律（不是大事，是小东西）
examples.example_text: It is never the big thing that undoes them. It is always some small thing instead.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「never the big / always the small」的对仗给出宿命感规则
examples.negative_instruction: 定律后必须给三个具体小东西（签名/指纹/生日电话）

examples.psychological_goal: 用孩子的天真信念处刑观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 天真信念引用（在天堂看着我）
examples.example_text: She writes that she knows he is watching over her from heaven.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让最无辜的角色用最大的误会说出安慰的话
examples.negative_instruction: 引用必须是角色自己的话，不可由叙述者替她抒情

examples.psychological_goal: 用克制的动作句号收束最大诱惑
examples.expression_mechanism: 动作句号+代价命名（你没有发送）
examples.example_text: You do not send it. This is the price of what you did.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在情绪峰值用一个否定的微小动作落地，再命名代价
examples.negative_instruction: 动作必须是「不做」而非「做」，克制才有力量

examples.psychological_goal: 用法律术语反写情感徒刑
examples.expression_mechanism: 术语挪用（人生没有诉讼时效）
examples.example_text: There is no statute of limitations on the life you abandoned.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习借用另一个领域的术语（刑法）给情感状态定性
examples.negative_instruction: 术语必须与故事的罪案语境相容，不可生硬嫁接

examples.psychological_goal: 让全片最苦的承认为牺牲「定价」
examples.expression_mechanism: 苦味承认（你的死是最好的事）
examples.example_text: Your death may have been the best thing that ever happened to your family.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让角色亲口承认他最不愿承认的事，作为主题重锤
examples.negative_instruction: 承认前必须铺满证据（她的婚礼/女儿的毕业），不可空降

examples.psychological_goal: 用升级比较给全片行为定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 升级比较（比死糟糕得多的事）
examples.example_text: You did not die that cold morning out on the water. You did something far worse than dying.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定一个终极事件，再给出比它更重的定性
examples.negative_instruction: 更重的定性必须立刻被解释（埋了他、扣为人质）

examples.psychological_goal: 用场景复制把结局接回开头
examples.expression_mechanism: 循环回收（另一个男人+同一张桌+同一时间）
examples.example_text: Somewhere right now another man is sitting at a kitchen table at 2:00 in the morning.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场场景逐字复制给一个新人物，让故事变成循环警告
examples.negative_instruction: 复制的元素必须与开场一一对应（桌/两点/账单），不可只写「又一个人」
